reviews.t: Great little gadget for beginners - a lot of pieces
reviews.x: For someone who has never even seen a nail gun, I can truthfully say this little gadget was not only easy to use, easy to hold and easy to learn, it has a lot of great parts that made doing my nails very easy and look good.  It has adjustable speed and an on & off button on the cord.  The only downside to this product is:  1. The instructions are not very detailed and for a new user, they make very little sense.  This is a great tool to learn on though.

reviews.t: Love! Easy to use. Adjustable speed and direction.
reviews.x: I really enjoy the shape and heft of the drill itself. Easy to get used to, they gave a lot of extra sander bits and it’s much appreciated. Nail drills can be costly and this one is probably your best bet if you want to start getting into nails and don’t want to go out and buy a super expensive one, when this one works just as great!

Bought this for my daughter. She began using dip polish and was having trouble getting the edges smooth. This electric drill is perfect. It is easy to use and very compact for easy storage. All of the accessories came with little cases to keep them organized. She is very happy with the purchase.
How do you turn this thing on?  I plugged it in and...NOTHING.  Also, I put one drill tip in, then when I pulled it out, it fell into two pieces.

reviews.t: Using to file my Smile retainers
reviews.x: This is a fine product for the purpose I purchased it for.  I would not recommend this item as a heavy duty nail filer.  I  use it for filing the bottom of my feet and it makes them very soft and smooth.  I have had pretty thick calluses on my feet and this did a wonderful job on them.  Using a different head attachment, I also use it to file down the top edges of my Smile retainers.  They come with pretty substantial edges that can cut into your gums and tongue. This is the first nail drill I've ever used and it was so simple, quiet and effective!  I have very strong, thick nails and this helped me with my diy pedicure perfectly!  It comes with so many bits and extras.  I am amazed at how much power this little nail drill has.  It goes in forward and reverse and you can easily adjust the speed.  Controls are located on the usb cord and don't get in the way, so no accidental unwanted adjustments happen while you're working.  It is powered by usb so no pe

reviews.t: Super Useful and easy to use!!
reviews.x: I’m so so so soooooo happy I got a nail drill. I’ve always struggled with my second toenails being a little more thick and rigid than the others.. this drill helped SO much in making them nice and buffed down to give my toenails a much better overall look. I recently got into doing gel at home and this helps prepping them SO much easier. I’m legitimately still excited over this. It’s lightweight, easy to use and pretty strong. I keep it close to the lowest setting which does the trick for me. It

I could not wait to use this, but I broke my leg and had not been able to use this until now.  I could not believe how light weight it is and how easy it is to use.  All the pieces that came with it are super nice.  I love that it is quiet and saves me time and money.  Now I can do my dip mails myself and not have to worry about wearing a mask at a salon.

I was really surprised at how well this little machine works! I was able to take my nail polish stickers off super easy, and without ruining my nails! It has more power than expected in such a small lightweight tool, and it’s pink! I am still learning about the tools, since there’s not much of an explanation in the manual, but this is really great tool!

I have a drill that cost more then this one and it works way better... love the pink color & its light. I tried it the moment i got it, i already had gel nail polish previously from going to the nail salon and it removed it fast and easily. Definitely worth getting specially if you rather do your nails at home. Overall love it!

I am in love with this nail file ... i have been going in for years to get my nails done and decided to try to do them myself snd this is the perfect nail file. It has so much power and the charge lasts a long time. I have bought many in the past and This one is better than what you see in the nail salons

I’m actually surprised at how well this worked. When I first received this nail drill, it wouldn’t turn on or work and I had it just sitting in its box for weeks until I tried it again and magically it turned on. The tools in the kit are great for artists of all types! Defiantly recommend when it works!

When I first bought this I was so happy because it was what I was looking for. It worked great up until it DIED! I literally have had this for maybe four months and it has been gently used during that time. DO NOT BUY unless you want the motor to blow a few months later.

reviews.t: Not worth it 3 use then nothing
reviews.x: I bought this November 7 used it about 3 times and now I just stopped working I tried plugging it in different power supply and nothing. I then called amazon and they told me there is nothing they can do. It was great for the few times I used it but not worth it.

The wire is too short and very loose. It did not come with a base, and after 3 usages, it will not turn on. I kept it in the packaging at all times, so it should turn on. So disappointed. Please do not buy the mailbox electric nail drill machine.

reviews.t: Great power and easy to use
reviews.x: Super easy to use and amazing for acrylics from home! Also is great to set your nails up for pollish. Comes with all the pieces you need and extra which is great! I love this electric nail filer because it’s already saved me so much money.

This nail drill is easy to use. I was looking through and ordered this one. There are many drills selling but I don't need to look for others. Satisfied, not too expensive, it also has the option of getting 5 percent off as you check out.

This was a gift for wife who is doing her nails by herself. She loved it! She said the drill works as good as the ones in nails saloons. Highly recommended! We will order two more to take as gifts to my wife's home country.

I recently started double my own nails and it has been a learning experience for sure. This was a necessary purchase after starting to use dip powder. With so many smart devices around, I don't see a very big issue with it.

I'm happy I chose this nail drill as my first drill. Its lightweight, easy to use and includes every bit you need for a perfect set of nails at home. I do recommend for beginners. It also has a switch for power low-high.

Amazing drill set! Love the extras it comes with, the nail file is beautiful and the brush is awesome! So happy it comes with more sanding bands too! Works awesome and having the 2 differ ways to spin it is awesome!

reviews.t: I don't need to go a nail spa anymore!
reviews.x: This kit gives me all that I need to have smooth, healthy looking nails. It also gave lots of replacement parts for sanding. It's a strong unit so I think care is important but I am excited to have it! Yay!

The color alone is breathtaking, easy to use and makes quarantine nails 100xS better! Saving money by not going to the salon to do what this machine can do at a very reasonable price! Highly recommend.
Stopped working after two uses...the cord needs to be better quality. It had a shortage upon second use. Smh. Otherwise no issue with the gun. I would have loved it if it wasn't for the cord.
My daughter has started doing nails and she needed this tool in order to get the nails done and this is a perfect starter kit! Definitely recommend if your looking for something inexpensive.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise it as easy to use and great for beginners, with many noting it is simple to learn and handle.
Many reviewers highlight that it comes with lots of bits, accessories, and extras, often organized in little cases.
Several reviewers are impressed by its power and performance despite its small, lightweight size, including removing gel polish and handling thick nails.
A notable number of negative reviews report the device stopped working or would not turn on after only a few uses or a few months.
Some reviewers mention durability or quality issues such as a drill tip breaking apart or a short, loose wire.
